Topic 1.4: Brushing teeth
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Brushing teeth, part of Myself 1.3 Handwashing (10 lesson) By the end of the Sub Strand the learner shou in SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we brush our teeth? 2. Why do we brush our teeth?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Brushing teeth together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
9

• Self-efficacy: learner gains confidence when demonstrating procedures of brushing teeth.

• Digital literacy: as learners manipulate digital devices to watch or listen to audio-visual clips on brushing of teeth.

Values:
Responsibility: learner observes safety precautions when brushing teeth.

Pertinent contemporary issues:

Personal hygiene: learners practises brushing own teeth.

Link to other learning area:

Routine brushing of teeth can be linked with concepts of time (routine activities) in Mathematical Activities

Suggested Learning Resources

Charts, picture cards, flash cards, braille cards, drawn pictures of toothbrush, glue, crayons, water, containers, toothpaste, toothbrush, resource

person, digital devices with assistive technology.
